display.purpose: The masthead's day number, the one moment allowed to be monumental.

headline.purpose: The single question a screen asks, in serif.

body.purpose: All readable sentences; never below 18sp, always 1.6 line height.

field-label.purpose: Tracked sans names for measured values: अंतर, पुढील भेट, आकृती 1.

value.purpose: Times, distances, counts in serif with tabular numerals.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The bottom sheet only. Every other layer of depth is a drawn rule or a paper shade.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Every pressable surface acknowledges the press without bouncing.

motion.name: sheet-enter
motion.purpose: Bottom sheet slides up over a warm ink scrim; reduced motion shows it in place.

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: List and register items settle in order, never all at once.

narrative.northStar: The household almanac, fused with the family medical book
narrative.overview: Doctor Mama is an older Marathi speaker's page, not a dashboard. It borrows the order of the दिनदर्शिका that hung by the door — a dated masthead, a 3dp ink rule, numbered entries, a red-ink stamp — and the warmth of the वैद्यकीय पुस्तक on the shelf: aged paper, a Devanagari serif, one line-drawn figure plate with its caption. Everything is ink on paper. There is no grey chrome, no floating card, and one red that means help is happening now.
keyCharacteristics: Aged paper ground with warm ink, no white surfaces
Devanagari serif for everything read; sans for field labels and controls
Rules and paper shades instead of shadows
Square corners; circles only for objects — avatar, SOS ring, microphone
One line-drawn figure plate per screen, captioned
Almanac red reserved for SOS, the emergency call and today's stamp

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red means help is happening now. SOS, the 108 call, and the stamp on today's visit. It never decorates a heading, a selected control or an icon.

rules.name: The Drawn Rule
rules.body: If a block needs to separate from the page, draw a rule or change the paper shade. Never add a drop shadow, a glow or a gradient.

rules.name: The Matra Floor
rules.body: Line height is always size × 1.6 and body text never falls below 18sp, because Devanagari matras sit above and below the baseline.

dos: Do set every line height at size × 1.6 and every body size at 18 or above.
Do draw a rule, change the paper shade, or add a stamp when something needs emphasis.
Do keep the number register two columns, each cell ≥56dp, the number in red ink.
Do put the primary action in the dock and the SOS in the same 34% slot on every screen.
Do write numbers in Latin digits and use commas, never middots.
Do verify text colour at ≥7:1 on its own ground before shipping a screen.
donts: Don't use red for selection, validation, decoration or a heading.
Don't add a shadow, glow, gradient, blur or glass surface; the sheet's shadow is the ceiling.
Don't round a corner, except the 3dp sheet and the three circular objects.
Don't put a small tracked label above a heading; the heading carries its own weight.
Don't use a coloured left or right border above 1dp, or nest a card inside a card.
Don't use an icon without a word, or a placeholder as a label.
Don't let a tap target fall below 56dp or move a primary action to the top of the screen.
